comment: artifact.c finesse_ahriman() 2254-2259, with do.c drop() 765 and 771: a debug neutral Barbarian wishes for the Heart of Ahriman (its own quest artifact, so touching it is safe), #invokes it to start levitating (ELevitation W_ARTI), then drops it. drop() cannot reach the floor, so it asks finesse_ahriman() whether letting go ends the levitation; with no other source, the probe finds Levitation would stop (TRUE), so drop() sets ELevitation to W_ART, lets the stone hit the floor, then floats the hero down.
